column1: # wiki_image_provenance.tsv -- binds each SHIPPED wiki image digest to the CM044
# source commit it was built from. verify_cut_freshness.sh reads this to answer
# "what source produced the image this cut actually pins?". Without a row a
# pinned digest is unverifiable and the gate is fail-closed RED.
# Format (TAB-delimited): <image-key>\t<sha256:digest>\t<cm044-source-sha>
# THE SHIP PATH (do not re-derive this from a local checkout -- see below)
# Wiki images are built by CM044 `.github/workflows/release-images.yml` on a
# `v*` TAG PUSH and published to ghcr.io/creativemachines-ai/ostler-wiki-{site,
# compiler} using the CM_AI_GHCR_PAT classic PAT. That is the LIVE pipeline.
# ghcr.io/ostler-ai/* is the DEPRECATED pre-#31 namespace -- images exist there
# but nothing publishes to it any more, so a pin against it ships whatever was
# last pushed by hand, with no source provenance.
# 2026-08-06 (v1.0.15): the pins below are byte-identical to CM051 origin/main.
# They resolve to tag v0.1.2 = commit cd79c502 = origin/main tip -- i.e. the
# images were built by CI from main, which is what "shipped truth" means.
# WHY THIS BANNER EXISTS. Earlier the same day I re-pinned both images to
# ghcr.io/ostler-ai at digests built from CM044 36cc552 -- a commit on the
# unmerged branch fix/on-this-day-current-year, four commits BEHIND main. That
# image therefore lacked four merged main fixes, including d0eea98 "hide mkdocs
# chrome when iframed in Ostler.app Wiki tab" (directly customer-visible in the
# Wiki tab). I then widened three gates to accept the deprecated namespace,
# which is what let the wrong pin through. This is the SECOND time this exact
# inversion has been made (the first, 2026-08-02, was reverted the same way).
# Both times the cause was reading release state off a local checkout instead of
# CM051 origin/main. Read origin/main. See memory reference_wiki_image_hosting.
# To ship a NEWER wiki (e.g. the reskin): merge the work to CM044 main, push a
# `v0.1.x` tag, let release-images.yml publish, then re-pin install.sh to the
# new creativemachines-ai digests and update the rows below. Do not hand-build
# and do not push to ostler-ai.
wiki-site
wiki-compiler
